title: Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.25760v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little when the agent also reasons at each step, but it helps an agent that does not reason, and it helps in longer episodes. Retained notes have a limit: when a later event makes a note wron

translated_title: 计算而非记忆：LLM智能体中的思维链与状态跟踪
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体通常在行动之前进行推理，而监控这种推理的价值取决于它与智能体行动之间的关系。我们探讨当正确的行动依赖于不断变化的状态时，智能体的行动如何依赖于其推理。在一个小型文件系统任务中，后台事件会宣布哪个文件的锁被切换，但不会宣布其新值。因此，智能体必须从历史记录中重建当前的锁状态，才能安全地移动文件。基于 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 模型，我们区分了推理的两种角色：在每次行动之前生成推理，以及在提示中保留早期推理。减少锁违规命令的收益大部分来自行动当下写出的推理。当智能体在每一步都进行推理时，保留早期推理几乎没有额外帮助；但对于不逐步推理的智能体，保留早期推理是有帮助的，并且在更长的回合中也是如此。保留的笔记有其局限：当后续事件使某条笔记变得不正确时……
tldr: 该论文通过区分“行动前即时生成推理”与“在提示中保留历史推理笔记”两种角色，发现真正减少状态违规行动的主要来源是行动时刻的即时推理（计算），而非记忆式的历史推理保留。
en_tdlr: Most of the reduction in state-violating actions by LLM agents comes from reasoning generated at the moment of action (computation), while retaining earlier reasoning notes (memory) only helps agents that do not reason per-step or in longer episodes.
